hook: Matt Van Horn benchmarks 16 agent browser and computer-use tools
hookText: Matt Van Horn benchmarks 16 agent browser and computer-use tools

beats.say: Testing 16 tools on one Apple Silicon Mac, Matt Van Horn picks cua-driver for native Mac apps and Ardia Browser or OpenCode browse for web automation.
Every tool ran the same five targets: example.com, Hacker News, a private GitHub repo, Apple Messages and an Electron app.
Ardia had the fastest warm page open and avoids Chrome's remote-debugging prompts; OpenCode browse kept Hacker News snapshots to 3,671 characters in 85 ms, about 53 times smaller than Stagehand.
